name: benchmark_suite_v7
description: Seven-problem suite extending v6 with chronological gas-turbine NOx emissions prediction.

repetition_protocol.dataset_policy: fixed train and test datasets across all algorithm trials
repetition_protocol.failure_policy: failed and missing trials are retained and reported separately

execution_controls.purpose: Reproducible resource control and measurement; these are not tuned model hyperparameters.

cantilever.sampling: sequential draws from one fixed generator

ccpp.source: UCI Combined Cycle Power Plant, DOI 10.24432/C5002N
ccpp.sampling: one seeded permutation; first 400 rows train and next 4000 rows test; no replacement or value preprocessing

naval_propulsion.source: UCI Condition Based Maintenance of Naval Propulsion Plants, DOI 10.24432/C5K31K
naval_propulsion.sampling: one seeded permutation of the full factorial simulator grid; first 400 rows train and next 4000 rows test; no replacement or value preprocessing

wing_weight.source: Forrester, Sobester, and Keane (2008), Engineering Design via Surrogate Modelling, DOI 10.1002/9780470770801

gas_turbine_nox.source: UCI Gas Turbine CO and NOx Emission Data Set, DOI 10.24432/C5WC95
gas_turbine_nox.sampling: 400 rows sampled without replacement from 2011-2013 and 4000 rows sampled without replacement from 2014-2015; no value preprocessing

gplearn.rationale: Reduced from the SRBench adapter's 1000 individuals and 500 generations to keep repeated trials computationally feasible; not selected using test performance.

operon.rationale: Restates the effective settings of the legacy Operon estimator in the pinned SRBench image for auditability.

pysr.rationale: Replaces the adapter's very long search with a 60-second practical budget and explicitly enforces deterministic single-process execution; not selected using test performance.

geneticengine.rationale: Reduces the adapter's one-hour allowance to a 60-second practical budget for repeated evaluation; not selected using test performance.

itea.rationale: Restates the population and generation settings already defined by the pinned SRBench adapter.

eql.rationale: Restates the 10000 optimization iterations already defined by the pinned SRBench adapter; the adapter's inactive candidate grid is not used.
